1  medium  The macOS application firewall is disabled (macos) [fw.app_firewall_disabled]
   Observed      fw.global#1 (07:12, as deploy): Firewall is disabled. (State = 0)
   Severity      medium
   Why here      scheck was not told how this machine is used (for example, whether it faces the
                 internet), so this is the standard rating.
   Fix           Turn the application firewall on in System Settings > Network > Firewall, or from
                 the command line.
                 Caveat: This is a per-application filter, not a packet filter; it does not replace
                   a network firewall.
                 Commands (review before running):
                   sudo /usr/libexec/ApplicationFirewall/socketfilterfw --setglobalstate on
